fit.title: Residual income / common equity
fit.reason: For an insurer, policy liabilities, investment assets and regulatory capital are central to value. Start with common book value and sustainable returns on equity; cross-check normalized earnings and distributions.
fit.caution: Review reserves, catastrophe cycles, investment marks, preferred capital and clean-surplus adjustments. Latest earnings may not represent normalized underwriting results.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
